context: Mass Alfa production increases documentation volume and cross-workspace coordination needs. We will activate the seventh genesis workspace to consolidate standards and runbooks and to own docs publishing.

directives.details: Draft a Standards Index covering naming/versioning, schema anchors, logs structure, and exchange paths.
Gather operator runbooks into a single index; link to authoritative copies in High Command exchange.
Outline offline-friendly docs CI/publish steps (even if manual), including targets and cadence.
Produce a clickable map of canonical docs with stable paths; add it to the Standards Index.
Submit a completion report with artifacts and follow-up items (e.g., search, linting).

success_criteria: Standards Index exists with initial sections and links
Runbook Index links to operator guides and comfort path
Docs publish plan recorded (manual or scripted)
